facts: Both donor optical absorption/emission crossings and electrochemical measurements are supplied as retrospective observations. They are not held-out labels.
Quenching observations concern 1a with 4-chloroanisole; they are not measurements for every donor.

Raw TCSPC decay traces and individual quenching-point instrumental errors are unavailable. Absolute lifetime summaries, rounded normalized lifetime ratios and the graphical quenching data are supplied; use conclusions commensurate with their resolution.
measurement_definitions: E00 denotes an absorption/emission crossing energy, with the wavelength and medium recorded. It is not defined as a Kohn–Sham orbital gap.

Electrode-referenced potentials require a stated electrode and electron convention. The supplied SCE values use the reported conversion; inconsistent reference labels remain unresolved and no universal offset is implied.
A molecular thermodynamic driving force does not by itself measure dissociation kinetics or product yield.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
